description: This file implements a modular script for processing a hardcoded video URL. It loads the video, runs object detection (YOLOv8m), filters for specific labels ('bear', 'dog', 'giraffe'), crops detected regions, classifies them, and performs pose estimation. It includes functions for video loading, model handling, detection filtering, cropping, classification, pose estimation, and per-frame reporting. The main pipeline orchestrates these steps across all video frames.
